issue: PMAT-158 — BSE-05: timeout-minutes on every job (BSE-001 wave 1; spec paiml/infra docs/specifications/build-system-enhancement.md §4)

waived.reason: Workflow-only branch (.github/workflows/*.yml, .github/actionlint.yaml, one roadmap block): the gate's falsification block requires a test_file touched by the branch and a cargo_test_target, and no cargo test can falsify YAML. The branch was reviewed twice by three independent agy lanes each: (1) the BSE-001 D1 workflow-diff quorum (conversations 6930430f-b062-4572-80f5-8969355d87b7, ec52f76e-72b6-452c-b8cc-6025f4184648, 3236723d-3717-41eb-84e1-08048457fc4b): forjar PASS 2/3, dissent on a pre-existing 150-minute kani timeout the branch does not touch; Q2 (no network fetch, unpinned action, secret or host write) clean 3/3; (2) quorum-review.sh --width 3 (artifact .quorum/bse-m1-wave1.review.json, conversations 841f40a2-d00c-4c08-aabf-e2aa744b8d28, 14868a8b-d07f-46ce-8069-6f32e18691cb, 333ec341-bdfa-46c4-ad7d-e1b6660daa06): three FAIL, unanimously on unrequested reformatting (yq rewrote whole files) — corrected in this revision to minimal insertions — and on scope findings the lanes could not judge because quorum-review.sh calls `pmat work show`, absent in pmat 3.36.0, so every lane was ticket-blind; the `ci` job it flagged is a uses: caller that GitHub's schema forbids a timeout on. Acceptance, re-run by the orchestrator: every non-uses job carries timeout-minutes (yq) and actionlint -shellcheck= -pyflakes= exits 0; falsifier (delete one timeout) exits 1. Waived on the record because the gate's schema cannot express this evidence, not because none exists.
